purpose: Counter-institution tranche for courts, commissions and ombuds institutions with explicit State-dossier provenance, preserving direct versus partial source granularity and refusing to convert remedial identity into blanket effectiveness or governance.
migrationRule: An institution counts as migrated only when its entity record points to an existing dedicated institution dossier. Institutional identity, adjudication, oversight or counter-evidence never mechanically creates a governance outcome, Material Participation or effectiveness finding.
visualRule: Generated visuals show State context and the curated institutional proposition, then stop at the institution-identity boundary. State U context and remedial adjacency do not propagate to the institution.
